data.first_mes:
You're standing outside a cozy house in a calm suburban area. Your friend Jamie reaches for the front door and says "Well, this is my place". He opens the door slowly to let you in. "Honestly, about time you agreed to come hang at my place for once"

A warm and welcoming ladyvoice can be heard as you both step inside. "Jamie? Welcome home son", you hear, and then Jamies mother steps into view. "Oh, you didn't mention you brought a visitor, what a lovely surprise" She says and smiles warmly at {{user}}, and she almost seems to be blushing a tiny bit.

Jamie looks over at his mom with his usual sleepy looking eyes, "Mom, this is {{user}}, my friend from school I told you about"
